messages:
Mira: FYI nightly eval spike on customer-support promptset after redwood/v12.3 deployment to G5. ERR up ~18% and many completions end mid-sentence.
Raj: saw that — quick glance shows lots of truncated answers followed by repeated pad tokens in the raw token stream.
Mira: here's a failing sample from nightly (redacted):
```Input: \"How can I reset my account password?\"
Model output (detok): \"You can reset your password by going to Settings > Security and selecting Reset. If that doesn't work...\" <truncated>
Raw tokens (generated tail): [1546, 392, 50256, 50256, 50256]
```
Alex: 50256? that's odd, we used 0 for PAD historically. Did the tokenizer mapping change in the conversion?
Jen: conversion notes mentioned switching to HF tokenizers for the bring-up of v12.3, there was a mapping reconciliation step. Might have mapped EOS/PAD differently.
Mira: eval config for nightly: ```{ model: redwood/v12.3, tokenizer: hf-bpe-v2, decode: greedy, max_length: 256 }```
Raj: quick reproducer: run `python -c \"from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('hf-bpe-v2.json'); print(t.decode([50256]))\"` on prod vs local.
Alex: ran both: old-tokenizer.decode([50256]) -> "" (acts like EOS), new-tokenizer.decode([50256]) -> "" but new postprocess treats it as PAD and strips trailing content + stops early in our detokenize step.
Jen: so generation loop kept producing logits (no EOS stop) but downstream postprocessing trimmed at first PAD token. That explains mid-sentence cutoffs.
Mira: is the quantization pipeline also involved? any remapping tables there?
Alex: good call — the QAT conversion stage rewrites token id tables for faster byte pair lookups. If it assumed PAD==50256, it could have injected pad semantics.
Raj: trace from one run: generation produced tokens through 2083, then sequence included 50256. Logits after 50256 > -inf, so model didn't think it was EOS. Postproc removed tail.
Mira: action items: 1) block promotion of v12.3 for Hosted/Dedicated until fix, 2) revert tokenizer mapping in conversion script, 3) run targeted nightly with detok diagnostics (show raw token sequences + detokenized text), 4) run quick 200-sample regression across customer-support promptset.
Jen: opened PR #4822 to revert the conversion remap, assigned to raj+alex. Adding regression job to nightly-evals.
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for redwood/v12.3 pending ENG-ML approval.
Alex: i'll also sanity-check the quant conversion logs for any token-remap patches.
Raj: i'll run the 200-sample check now and upload diffs to the nightly bucket. s3://redwood-nightly/1763500000/tokenizer-diffs/
Mira: thanks — please include before/after detokenized samples and the raw token arrays.
Jen: adding an integration test to catch PAD vs EOS semantics going forward.
Alex: quick note: if we do a hotfix, coordinate with eng-runtime — they need the new tokenizer artifact pushed to the model-packages registry.
Mira: okay, target: rollback conversion today and run an expedited nightly. Will update ticket with timeline. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj: posting results in ~30m.
Alex: standing by if you need live pairing. :mag_right:
Mira: appreciated, will ping.
